On Writing Slowly

a newsletter about doing less, better

Substack and similar platforms wrap their entire layout in nested <center> elements for compatibility with old email clients, which would otherwise centre-align the whole article body on a Kindle if left unstripped. This fixture is an originally-authored approximation of that markup pattern - it is not copied from any actual publication - written to exercise the same sanitize_html code path (the <center> unwrap step) that real Substack newsletters trigger.

A second paragraph, so word-count-gated pipeline logic has enough content to clear its threshold during end-to-end tests.
